shortDescription: Cloud9's win probability in the Polymarket submarket for the LCS playoff match between Cloud9 and LYON fell sharply from 36.5% one hour ago to 17.5%, a 19 percentage point drop. According to ChainCatcher, the move was tracked by Catcher Predict in the market for the best-of-five event.
